text:
Harper: Dropping a 1-pager draft called 'Executive Slate'  single-page sell sheet for security-conscious buyers. Focus: quick decision signals + deploy-mode tradeoffs + 30s webinar hook. Link: https://docs.google.com/executive-slate (internal)
Diego: Nice layout. Can we give a 3-question sales qualification at the top? e.g., regulated data, predictable throughput, latency-sensitive UI.
Faiza: Add a concise procurement line: "Expected unit delta vs Hosted" with a tiny number band (e.g., +30%-60%) so buyers have a ballpark.
Tom: Ops wants a micro-failover story with sequence diagram language for the slide: primary -> canary -> fallback pool. Keep it one sentence.
Harper: I added a 3-row micro-table (Latency | Cost predictability | Data control) with one-phrase cells and a one-sentence recommendation per mode.
Diego: Can we include tiny benchmark callouts for two workloads: ecomm pilot (10k msgs/day) p95=120ms, finserv scale (50k msgs/day) p95=210ms, and a $/1k token delta estimate? One line each.
Faiza: Compliance bullets: SOC2 Type II, customer-managed KMS support, optional HSM, audit-log retention. Reworded to be customer-facing.
Tom: For the webinar registration blurb: 2 bullets only: 1) "How to pick a deploy mode that meets security & latency goals" 2) "Real failover demo + benchmarks"
Harper: Added a short "What to ask the customer" checklist with 4 quick prompts for reps.
Diego: I'll export a simple CSV mapping for SalesOps: headers = email,company,deploy_interest,compliance_flag,monthly_token_estimate. Will attach to the doc.
Faiza: For the canary snippet use this compact YAML so it's slide-friendly: ```yaml
canary:
  percent: 10
  watch: 20m
  fallback: enabled
```
Tom: Tone tweak: change any absolute promises to "target SLA" and add an escalation line: "Enterprise P1 response target: 1hr"
Harper: CTA: "Book a 20-min field demo" plus a small qualification checkbox that lists minimum monthly tokens and security requirements.
Diego: I'll drop a one-line sales voicemail script for webinar follow-ups.
Faiza: I'll do a final compliance sweep tonight and remove any legalese.
ops-bot: Note: linked doc updated 18 minutes ago by Harper
Harper: Timeline: need final PDF by Friday 08:00 for the promo batch. Can folks sign off by Thu EOD?
Diego: I can lock tagging CSV by Thu noon.
Faiza: Compliance sign-off by Thu 6pm.
Tom: I'll finalize the slide-friendly canary diagram and bench numbers by Thu 4pm.
Harper: Thanks team. I'll merge and post the PDF Thu night. :sparkles:
